messages:
maria: Heads up — int8 canary (eu-west-1) after merge 4021 showing 20-30% p99 increase for text-gen workloads. Rolling back paused but wanted to surface. :sos:
perf-bot: CI perf job: https://ci/redwood/jenkins/job/quant_CANARY/558 — p99 tokens/sec -12% vs baseline.
devon: Do we have a profile? Which hot path?
sylvia: Quick profile from the canary instance attached: hotloop breakdown shows dequant op time jumped from 1.2ms -> 9.1ms per token on seq>512 inputs.
devon: that's huge. Kernel selector choosing `dequant_generic` kernel for int8_v2 when seq_len >= 512, instead of `dequant_streamed` we used previously.
chao: I think the selector change in 4021 added a fallback for "cache-friendly" kernels; fallback condition seems inverted.
ankit: also noticing KV cache eviction count spiked — might cause repeated full-dequant calls instead of prefix-KV reuse.
maria: logs: `dequant_generic: batch=8 seq=768 time=9.12ms`, `matmul: 2.45ms` — dequant is dominating.
devon: Can someone bisect which commit in 4021 landed the selector change? Maybe a single hunk.
sylvia: I'll run a quick local bisect on the canary image. Steps: build v4019 (pre-merge), v4021-1 (hunk removed), run micro-bench for seq=768, batch 8.
perf-bot: micro-bench results posted: v4019 p99=12.3ms, v4021 p99=16.8ms, v4021-1 p99=12.4ms
devon: confirms selector hunk is culprit. Suggest revert until we push a patch.
ankit: also propose a short-term mitigation: force `dequant_streamed` for batch_size<=16 and seq_len>=512 via runtime flag `--quant-dequant-policy=legacy_stream`.
maria: Patch PR open: https://git/redwood/pulls/4072 — revert selector inversion + add runtime flag.
sylvia: Running canary with PR 4072 now. Initial telemetry shows p99 back to baseline after 10k requests. :thumbsup: 
chao: note: we should add a unit micro-benchmark for dequant kernels and a regression CI gate.
devon: agreed — adding `quant-dequant-smoke` job to perf CI with seq 512/768 and small batches.
maria: thank you. We'll hold rollout until CI + canary stable. Reverting merge in prod in 30m.
ankit: follow-up: we should also investigate KV cache fragmentation — might be contributing. Filed issue #1234.
perf-bot: Incident status updated: rollout blocked -> mitigated. :white_check_mark:
